1-s4.condition: Unit 1 «Holidays Are Over», Reading, упр. 1, с. 4. Прочитай текст и закончи предложения после него, обведя нужный вариант (a–c).

2-s5.condition: Unit 1, Reading, упр. 2, с. 5. A) Прочитай текст и скажи, почему девочке понравились летние каникулы. B) Определи, какие утверждения верны, неверны или не указаны.
steps: A) The girl liked her summer holidays because she travelled with her best friend. They had a good time: played volleyball, read books and helped her friend's mother in the garden.
B) True — 1, 5; False — 7; Not stated — 2, 3, 4, 6.
2-s5.answer: A: путешествовала с лучшей подругой, весело провели время; B: T 1,5 / F 7 / NS 2,3,4,6

steps: Верные утверждения: 3, 6, 7, 8, 10.

8-s8.condition: Unit 1, Reading, упр. 8, с. 8. Прочитай предложения с глаголами в Past Simple вслух.
steps: Читаем предложения вслух, обращая внимание на неправильные глаголы (went, saw, took, had).

9-s9.condition: Unit 1, Speaking, упр. 9, с. 9. Выбери один из вариантов (a–c) и скажи, как ты собираешься провести ближайшие выходные.
steps: a) I'm going to go to the country. I will have a good time. I'm going to help my grandparents in the garden. With my friends we are going to walk to the river and swim. In the evening we're going to sit by the fire.
Можно выбрать b) город или c) дома — главное, использовать be going to.
9-s9.answer: I'm going to + планы на выходные

10-s9.condition: Unit 1, Speaking, упр. 10, с. 9. Прочитай словосочетания и сравни осень в Москве и в Лондоне.
steps: Autumn is a nice season both in Moscow and in London.
In Moscow and in London early autumn is fine and warm.
Late autumn in London is not so cold as in Moscow, but it is rainier and foggier.
In Moscow it often snows in November; in London it seldom snows in autumn.
10-s9.answer: Ранняя осень тёплая в обоих городах; поздняя осень в Лондоне дождливее и туманнее, в Москве холоднее

11-s9.condition: Unit 1, Speaking, упр. 11, с. 9. В парах: один из Москвы, другой из Лондона. Поговорите об осени в этих городах.
steps: — Hello, I'm from London. It's early autumn now. It is warm and people spend a lot of time in the parks. What about early autumn in Moscow?
— Early autumn in Moscow is warm and sunny too. But late autumn is cold, and in November it often snows.
— In London late autumn is rainy and foggy, but it seldom snows.
— I'd like to see London in autumn!
11-s9.answer: Диалог о погоде осенью в Москве и Лондоне

12-s10.condition: Unit 1, Speaking, упр. 12, с. 10. Расскажи, как прошли твои каникулы (где был, погода, что делал, что понравилось).
steps: My summer holidays were wonderful. I travelled a lot.
In June my parents and I went to the Red Sea. The weather was wonderful, it was not very hot. I swam in the sea, played volleyball and read books.
In July I visited my grandparents in the country. I helped them in the garden and rode my bike.
In August I stayed at home and met my friends. I liked my holidays very much.
12-s10.answer: Рассказ о каникулах в Past Simple: 6–8 предложений

13-s10.condition: Unit 1, Speaking, упр. 13, с. 10. Прочитай текст и скажи, какими были осенние каникулы Ника и почему они ему понравились.
steps: Nick and his family had a great time in Brussels. They stayed in a hotel in the centre of the city, visited several interesting places and liked Brussels a lot. The weather was fine. Nick liked the holidays because he saw a new country and ate tasty Belgian chocolate.
13-s10.answer: Ник ездил с семьёй в Брюссель: отель в центре, интересные места, хорошая погода

20-s15.answer: colder, nastier, most comfortable, strongest/stronger, better, dearer, more interesting, happiest, best/worst, tastiest

21-s16.condition: Unit 1, Use of English, упр. 21, с. 16. Переведи предложения и скажи, согласен ли ты с ними (as … as / not so … as).
steps: 1) Girls are usually not so strong as boys. — Обычно девочки не такие сильные, как мальчики.
2) Old houses are usually not so comfortable as new ones. — Старые дома обычно не так удобны, как новые.
3) Autumn school holidays are as long as spring holidays. — Осенние каникулы такие же длинные, как весенние.
4) Chocolate ice cream is as tasty as vanilla ice cream. — Шоколадное мороженое такое же вкусное, как ванильное.
5) Plum trees are not so tall as apple trees.
21-s16.answer: as … as — так же, как; not so … as — не так, как

22-s17.condition: Unit 1, Use of English, упр. 22, с. 17. Составь предложения с конструкцией not so … as по картинкам.
steps: 1) The wall is not so high as the tower.
2) The chocolate cake was not so tasty as the apple pie.
3) The kitten is not so big as the dog.
4) The book is not so interesting as the film.
5) Today is not so cold as yesterday.
22-s17.answer: первый объект + is/was + not so + прилагательное + as + второй объект

24-s19.condition: Unit 1, Writing, упр. 24, с. 19. Заполни таблицу: перевод, глагол, форма Past Simple.
steps: делать — do — did; пить — drink — drank; есть — eat — ate; брать — take — took; давать — give — gave; писать — write — wrote; читать — read — read; встречать — meet — met; иметь — have — had; начинать — begin — began.
24-s19.answer: did, drank, ate, took, gave, wrote, read, met, had, began

25-s19.condition: Unit 1, Writing, упр. 25, с. 19. Напиши письмо другу о своих летних каникулах по плану.
steps: Dear Sasha,
How is everything? I would like to tell you about my summer holidays.

I enjoyed the summer very much! In June I went to the seaside with my parents. The weather was hot and sunny. I swam, played beach volleyball and ate a lot of ice cream. In July I visited my granny in the country. I helped her in the garden and went fishing with my grandad.
What about your holidays? Write soon.
Best wishes, Anna
25-s19.answer: Письмо: приветствие, вступление, рассказ о каникулах, вопрос другу, прощание

26-s20.condition: Unit 1, Writing, упр. 26, с. 20. Напиши о погоде в том месте, где ты живёшь, ответив на вопросы.
steps: 1) In my city summer is sunny and hot. Spring is sunny and windy, sometimes rainy. Autumn is rainy and windy. Winter is cold and snowy.
2) It is often windy in spring and autumn. It is foggy in late autumn.
3) The sun shines about 200 days a year.
4) Yes, it is very cold in winter. In summer it is sometimes very hot.
5) You can swim in the river in late spring and early autumn.
6) Yes, I usually like the weather in my city.
26-s20.answer: Описание погоды по сезонам в своём городе

27-s20.condition: Unit 1, Writing, упр. 27, с. 20. Напиши, что ты делал(а) в прошлое воскресенье (Past Simple).
steps: Last Sunday I got up at 11 o'clock. I brushed my teeth and had breakfast with my family. We went to a café and ordered pancakes. Then we walked in the park. In the evening I read a book and watched TV. I went to bed at ten.
27-s20.answer: Рассказ о воскресенье в Past Simple: 6–8 предложений

28-s21.answer: October, cloud, windy, November, yellow, vegetables, autumn, rain, September, foggy, cold, wet

29-s22.condition: Unit 1, Writing, упр. 29, с. 22. Переведи текст о Колине на английский.
steps: It was a day in early autumn. The weather was nice. Colin, a twelve-year-old boy, got up early because the cars in the street were very loud. He took his dog and went for a walk in the park. The trees were yellow and red. Colin liked autumn very much.
29-s22.answer: Перевод текста в Past Simple: got up, took, went, were, liked

8-s28.condition: Unit 2, Speaking, упр. 8, с. 28. Ответь на вопросы о своей семье.
steps: My parents work in our family. My sister is a student. My father can drive. My parents are going to travel in summer. My mother buys bread, milk and vegetables. My grandparents live in the country. I help my mum about the house.
8-s28.answer: Ответы о своей семье: кто работает, кто учится, кто водит машину, кто ходит в магазин

9-s28.condition: Unit 2, Speaking, упр. 9, с. 28. Задай вопросы другу о его семье.
steps: Is your family big? How many people are there in your family? Who are they? What does your father do? What does your mother do? What do they like doing? Have you got a brother or a sister? Where do your grandparents live? What are you going to do at the weekend?
9-s28.answer: Вопросы о семье: Is …? How many …? What does … do? Have you got …? Where …?

10-s28.condition: Unit 2, Speaking, упр. 10, с. 28. Расскажи об идеальной семье, ответив на вопросы.
steps: In my ideal family there are two children. All the members of the family live together. They spend weekends on picnics and at home playing games. On holidays they travel together. Parents help children with their homework and children help about the house. They never shout and always talk kindly.

11-s29.condition: Unit 2, Speaking, упр. 11, с. 29. Прочитай текст и расскажи, что ты знаешь о Джоне Ленноне.
steps: John Lennon was a singer and musician. He was born in Liverpool in 1940. He lived with his aunt Mimi and uncle George. John started a band in 1957. John Lennon and Paul McCartney wrote a lot of famous songs for the Beatles. John died in 1980 in New York.
11-s29.answer: Джон Леннон: родился в Ливерпуле в 1940, жил с тётей Мими, основал группу в 1957, писал песни с Маккартни

12-s29.condition: Unit 2, Use of English, упр. 12, с. 29. Составь 6 предложений о том, что ты умеешь сейчас и что умел/не умел раньше (can / could / couldn't).

Now I can swim. When I was five, I couldn't swim.
Now I can read English. When I was six, I could read Russian, but I couldn't read English.
Now I can ride a bike. When I was three, I couldn't ride a bike.

19-s34.condition: Unit 2, Use of English, упр. 19, с. 34. Соедини слова в словосочетания и впиши их в предложения 1–9.
steps: Словосочетания: go to university — поступить в университет; grow roses — выращивать розы; become a businessman — стать бизнесменом; leave for London — уехать в Лондон; get married — пожениться; dream about a career — мечтать о карьере; look after children — присматривать за детьми; be born in April — родиться в апреле; stay at a hotel — остановиться в отеле.

20-s35.condition: Unit 2, Use of English, упр. 20, с. 35. Запиши, в какое время года родились родственники из списка.
steps: Winter — December, January, February; spring — March, April, May; summer — June, July, August; autumn — September, October, November.

My mother was born in spring (in April). My father was born in winter (in January). My grandmother was born in summer (in July). My grandfather was born in autumn (in October). My aunt was born in summer (in June).

22-s37.condition: Unit 2, Writing, упр. 22, с. 37. Запиши формы Past Simple глаголов 1–16.
